videos.script: Lesson 2 rebuilt hits on Cobra. This lesson rebuilds it again, on urfave/cli, the library people call the lighter alternative. {{shape}} The program becomes one value. A command holds its flags, its subcommands and the function that runs. You write it as a literal and call Run. {{flags}} The flags get better at once. They work after the file name. One can have a second name, read an environment variable, and refuse a bad value. The help writes itself from all of that. {{errors}} Then the part a framework hides. Its defaults print help on the wrong stream, invent an exit code, and call os.Exit from inside Run. Three hooks put lesson 1's contract back, and a table test holds it there. {{measure}} Last, the word lighter, measured. Three versions of the same tool, side by side: binary size, modules, packages and lines. One result is not what the word suggests. By the end you can choose between the three for your next tool, and say why.
